name: StockEasy
project_type: Full-Stack Multi-Tenant Pharmacy Management and POS Platform

overview.value: StockEasy is a full-stack, multi-tenant pharmacy management and POS platform designed to support inventory management, billing, analytics, role-based access control, and pharmacy operations.

multi_tenancy.implementation: Major business tables contain a shop_id identifier representing the pharmacy tenant. PostgreSQL Row Level Security policies restrict access to rows belonging to the appropriate tenant.

protection: Tenant blacklist checks using Upstash Redis

fefo.name: First-Expire-First-Out
fefo.description: StockEasy uses expiration information to prioritize inventory batches with the nearest expiration dates so those batches can be used first.

realtime.purpose: Provides live updates for analytics-related information such as inventory and sales data.

background_processing.purpose: Handles asynchronous background events such as transactional email workflows so background operations do not unnecessarily block the primary application flow.

ai_integration.purpose: Provides an AI-powered analytics assistant within StockEasy.

engineering_challenges.solution: Implemented FEFO-based inventory recommendations to prioritize medicines approaching expiration.
Implemented PostgreSQL Row Level Security using tenant identifiers such as shop_id.
Integrated Supabase Realtime subscriptions for live dashboard updates.
Implemented TOTP-based 2FA, PKCE authentication, tenant blacklist checks, and rate limiting.
Used Upstash QStash for asynchronous transactional email workflows.

postgresql.reason: StockEasy contains strongly structured relationships between pharmacies, users, inventory, batches, bills, and other business entities. PostgreSQL also provides Row Level Security, which supports the application's tenant-isolation strategy.

supabase.reason: Supabase provides PostgreSQL together with authentication and realtime capabilities, allowing several backend requirements to be integrated around the same database platform.

redis.reason: Upstash Redis is used where low-latency key-value access is useful, including tenant blacklist checks and rate limiting.

qstash.reason: QStash is used for asynchronous background processing so transactional email workflows do not unnecessarily block the main application flow.

technical_highlights: Redis-based rate limiting and tenant blacklist checks
